Heard you had some trouble with your bike. That's the problem with baby toys. They break so easy.''"
"''We can still race!''"
"''Really? Be there this weekend. If your mommy lets you. Bye, losers!|Bonjj Phalfa and Fern|audio=Phalfa-Fern-SC1.flac|}} '''Bonjj Phalfa''' was a [[human]] [[Homeworld|native]] of the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] who owned a [[Color|blue]] [[Bonjj Phalfa's hoverbike|hover bike]]. Around [[9 ABY]], he had plans to [[Hoverbike racing|race]] against the [[At Attin Middle School Gamma|middle school]] student [[Fern]] and mocked her and her [[Fern and KB's hoverbike|bike]] after it broke down. When the [[pirate]] [[Jod Na Nawood]] later [[Invasion of At Attin|cut power]] to the [[Unidentified city (At Attin)|city]] where Phalfa lived, [[Wendle]], [[Parent|father]] of Fern's friend [[Wim]], took Phalfa's [[Hoverbike|bike]] to chase after his [[Gender|son]]. ==Biography== ===Racing rival=== {{Quote|Who cares about racing Bonjj Phalfa?''"
"''I care.|KB and Fern|audio=KB-Fern-Phalfa-SC1.flac|}} [[File:PhalfaAndFriends-SC1.png|thumb|right|300px|Bonjj Phalfa mocked Fern and KB.]] The [[human]] Bonjj Phalfa was a [[Homeworld|native]] of the [[planet]] [[At Attin]], which was separated from the rest of [[the galaxy]] by the [[Barrier]]. Around [[9 ABY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} he owned a racing [[Bonjj Phalfa's hoverbike|hover bike]] and had plans to [[Hoverbike racing|race]] with the [[At Attin Middle School Gamma|middle school]] student [[Fern]] but learned that her [[Fern and KB's hoverbike|bike]] had broken down. With a human and a [[Rodian]] passenger in a sidecar, he flew up to the [[KB's home|home]] of Fern's friend [[KB]], where the pair were working on the broken [[Hoverbike|bike]] in the garage. Phalfa called out to them and belittled Fern's [[Speeder bike|bike]], prompting her to angrily retort that she would still be able to race. He was doubtful, but told Fern that the race would take place on the weekend, mockingly suggesting that she come as long as her [[Parent|mother]], [[Undersecretary]] [[Fara]], let her. Phalfa and his two passengers then flew away. KB suggested to Fern that they ask to postpone the race, but Fern refused, as she believed that she had to act tough to deal with Phalfa. However, the pair did not make the race as, in their quest for replacement parts for the [[Speeder|bike]], KB and Fern accidentally boarded a [[Onyx Cinder|ship]] that took them offworld. ===I need your bike=== KB, Fern, and their [[Skeleton Crew|friends]] [[Neel]] and [[Wim]] later returned to At Attin but unknowingly brought the [[pirate]] [[Jod Na Nawood]] with them. Na Nawood [[Invasion of At Attin|took control]] of the planet and [[Death|destroyed]] [[the Supervisor]] who oversaw it, resulting in a power outage across the [[Unidentified city (At Attin)|city]] where Phalfa lived. During the blackout, Phalfa sat on his [[Repulsorcraft|hover bike]] on the side of a suburban road and watched as Fern, Wim, and Neel raced past on their own hover bikes.{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} [[File:Phalfa-Wendle-SC8.png|left|thumb|300px|Wendle took Bonjj Phalfa's hover bike.]] Wim's father, [[Wendle]], then ran up alongside Phalfa while chasing the three [[Youngling|children]]. The pair exchanged a glance, after which Wendle took Phalfa's bike in order to pursue his son and the others. Wendle rode the bike all the way to the [[Supervisor's Tower]], where he, the children, and Fara managed to thwart Na Nawood's plans and call the [[New Republic]] to At Attin to defeat [[Silvo's pirates|Na Nawood's crew]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|You gotta act tough. It's the only way to deal with jerks like that.|Fern talks about Phalfa|audio=Fern-ActTough-SC1.flac|}} Phalfa was a bully{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-highlights-108|text=''Skeleton Crew'' Explained | Episode 8 - "The Real Good Guys"}} and mocked Fern's bike, calling it a baby toy, and suggested that she was controlled by her mother. Fern considered Phalfa a jerk. He had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and green [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Bonjj Phalfa flew a blue hover bike and wore a black [[jacket]] with various emblems sewn onto the sleeves and shoulders. He also wore a pair of fingerless black [[glove]]s, brown pants, and brown shoes. ==Behind the scenes== Bonjj Phalfa was portrayed by [[Shané Almagor]] in "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]," the first episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}} Bonjj Phalfa's name and taunting of Fern is a homage to actor [[Harrison Ford]]'s character [[w:c:americangraffiti:Bob Falfa|Bob Falfa]] from [[Wikipedia:American Graffiti|''American Graffiti'']],{{SW|url=season-1-episode-1-trivia-gallery-skeleton-crew|text="This Could Be a Real Adventure" Trivia Gallery | Skeleton Crew}} {{C|Slide 4}} a [[1973]] film written and directed by ''[[Star Wars]]'' director [[George Lucas]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]'' ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{1st}} *{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-1-episode-guide|text="This Could Be a Real Adventure" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}} *{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-highlights-108|text=''Skeleton Crew'' Explained | Episode 8 - "The Real Good Guys"}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Bonjj Phalfa|imagecat=Images of Bonjj Phalfa}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Bonjj Phalfa |ja=ボンジ・ファルファ |ka=ბონჯჯ ფალფა }} [[Category:At Attin residents]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
